column1: One row per question, shown in Order. Result role: Classification = shown as the maturity badge (use for one question only); Signal = shown as a signal tile; None = not shown directly. Helper text is the internal rationale and is not shown to visitors. Landing page blurb is the one-line description shown on the landing page.

column4: How would you describe where your L&D function is today?
column5: This tells us in 10 seconds whether we're talking to a CLO building from scratch, a mature team looking to scale, or someone drowning in legacy content.
column6: Understand where your learning and development function stands today.

column4: What is your single biggest L&D challenge right now?
column5: This surfaces the immediate pain that brought you here and helps pinpoint where we need to focus first.
column6: Identify the biggest barriers limiting learning effectiveness and growth.

column4: How is your training currently being delivered?
column5: This reveals the reality of your current learning ecosystem and helps identify structural gaps.
column6: Review how learning is currently designed, delivered, and supported.

column4: Tell us about your internal L&D team and how you currently get work done.
column5: A team of one building for 10,000 employees is a very different conversation from a large team that just needs specialized external skills.
column6: Understand whether your current team and resources can support your goals.

column4: If you look back a year from now, what does great look like for your L&D function?
column5: This shifts the focus from "what do you need now" to "what are you trying to become," framing the ultimate goal of our assessment.
column6: Clarify what your L&D function should achieve over the next 12 months.
